dataset: EgoObjects v1 plus LVIS v1 supplement
notes: All images belonging to one EgoObjects group_id are assigned to exactly one split.
The source val/test subset labels overlap heavily by group_id, so all complete groups were deterministically re-split 80/10/10.
One complete coin group was moved from train to val so every one of the 15 classes is measurable in train, val, and test.
EgoObjects does not provide card or small_block categories; those two classes are supplemented from official LVIS v1 annotations and COCO images.
